articles.title: CBI searches 4 manpower firms over alleged hiring, pay irregularities
articles.description: CBI raids 4 Chandigarh manpower firms over alleged outsourcing tender, hiring and salary irregularities; probe examines GeM contracts and possible official role.

articles.title: India sets zero sugar diversion for ethanol in 2026/27 tender
articles.description: India has relied for years on surplus sugar to meet its ethanol-blending targets, but the exclusion of sugar-based feedstocks underscores the growing tension between cutting oil imports and protecting domestic sugar supplies, as poor rainfall threatens output and pushes prices to record highs.

articles.title: Centre sets sugar diversion for ethanol at zero in 2026-27 tender
articles.description: India has directed oil marketing companies to exclude sugar-based ethanol from the 2026-27 tender, setting sugar diversion at zero amid concerns over domestic sugar supplies and record-high prices.
